---
title: "Iterating Over Arrays Safely"
---

# Iterating Over Arrays Safely

Never iterate over unquoted arrays or use `${array[*]}`. Always iterate with `"${array[@]}"`:

```bash
files=("file with spaces.txt" "another.log")

# SAFE: Preserves whitespace boundaries
for file in "${files[@]}"; do
    echo "Processing: $file"
done

# Iterating by index (for parallel or indexed arrays):
for i in "${!files[@]}"; do
    echo "Index $i contains ${files[$i]}"
done
```
